steps.caption: Source registry: each source with what it is for, its connection status, permission, last sync, refresh interval and how often it was used.
News / RSS feeds are Unavailable — needs access: no licensed feed is set up, so paste articles by hand instead. A failed source is always labelled — never shown as 'no news'.
Your CRE OS records — leases, occupancy, availability — are connected and scanned daily.
Manual paste and uploaded documents are on-demand sources.
Pause stops a source; Resume starts it again; Reconnect retries one that needs access.
Refresh now runs the scheduled refresh for companies that are due.
Recent runs: when each source ran and how many new items it found.
Failed items and jobs: anything that failed, with the error and a Retry button.
Research universe: how many companies are actively kept up to date, and how often each tier is refreshed — weekly, monthly or quarterly.
Change the universe size (50 to 8,000 companies) and Save.
